equations.longitudinal_dynamics: m*dv/dt = F_drive + m*g*sin(theta) - C_rr*m*g*cos(theta) - 0.5*rho*Cd*A*v^2 - F_retarder - F_brake
equations.effective_deceleration: a_dec = [ min(F_brake_max, mu*m*g*cos(theta)) + C_rr*m*g*cos(theta) + F_aero - m*g*sin(theta) ] / m
equations.safe_speed_optimizer: v_safe = min(v_stop, v_retarder, v_traction, v_curve, v_mine)
equations.inverse_friction_estimator: mu_meas = [ g*sin(theta) - C_rr*g*cos(theta) - F_retarder/m - F_aero/m - a_x ] / [ g*cos(theta) ]

limitations: Lateral dynamic rollover instability not fully coupled with longitudinal dynamic load transfer.
Tire slip curve linearity assumed under transient brake onset.
Friction estimation requires measured retarder torque and road grade input to remain identifiable.
